definitions.latency_ms: synchronized wall time per request, including prefix miss, suffix execution, and cleanup
definitions.revisit: visit_index > 0; a revisited user may have been evicted and miss again
definitions.quantiles: linear interpolation at (n - 1) * p over measured requests
definitions.empty_scope: count is zero and latency statistics are null
definitions.budgets: equal allowed HBM/DRAM cache caps; actual allocated bytes may differ
definitions.phase_times: reported separately when measured; total latency is authoritative
